common.disclaimer: KhaoSahi gives general diet and lifestyle information. It does not diagnose or treat any disease. Always follow your doctor's advice and talk to them before changing your diet or medicines.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.body: Sorry, the app hit a problem. Your data is safe on this phone. Please try again.

today.allDone: Well done! You finished today's list.
today.itemHint: Marks this item as done or not done
today.streakHint: A day counts when 70% or more of the list is done.
today.day90Body: See your summary and talk to your doctor about repeating your tests.
today.emptyTitle: Your plan is not ready yet
today.emptyBody: Fill in your profile to get your 90-day plan.

list.noProfileNote: Ratings cover both fatty liver and uric acid. Set up your profile to see only yours.
list.emptySearch: Nothing matches “{{query}}”. Try another spelling, Hindi or Hinglish, or change the filters.
list.emptyBrowse: No foods in this category for the selected diet.

detail.title: Food details
detail.notFoundBody: We could not find this food. Please go back and search again.

plan.overviewIntro: Each week has a small focus. Tap a week to see how it went.
plan.restartBody: You will start again from Day 1 today. Your past days stay saved.
plan.weekNotStarted: This week has not started yet.
plan.noFinishedDays: No finished days yet. A day is counted after it ends.
plan.countNote: A day counts as completed when 70% or more of the list is done. Today is added after midnight.
plan.noPlanBody: Fill in your profile to get your 90-day plan.

day90.title: Your 90-day summary
day90.notYet: You are on Day {{day}}. Your full summary is ready on Day 90.
day90.measurementsNote: First reading of this plan and your latest reading.
day90.doctorBody: Ask your doctor if it is time to repeat your tests (liver tests, ultrasound or uric acid). Your doctor can explain what your results mean.
day90.keepGoing: Healthy habits may help more when you keep them up. You can restart the plan any time.

learn.extrasBody: Optional guides. Watch a short ad to unlock one. Food ratings, safety information and the disclaimer are always free.
learn.watchToUnlock: Watch a short ad to unlock
learn.adUnavailable: No ad is available right now. Please try again later.
learn.adNotEarned: The ad was closed early, so this extra is still locked. You can try again.
learn.lockedBody: This optional guide unlocks after a short ad.
learn.notFoundBody: This article is not available. Please go back and pick another one.

settings.exportHint: Shares a backup file (JSON) of your data. You choose where it goes.
settings.exportFailed: Could not export your data. Please try again.
settings.deleteHint: Removes everything from this phone and starts the app fresh.
settings.deleteConfirmBody: This will permanently delete your profile, lab values, progress logs, checklist and reminders from this phone. This cannot be undone. Export your data first if you want a copy.
settings.deleteFailed: Could not delete all data. Please try again.
settings.linkFailed: Could not open the link. Please try again later.

notice.whatBody: Your profile (age, height, weight, waist, diet, region and condition), lab values you enter, your progress logs, your daily checklist and your reminder settings.
notice.whereBody: Only on this phone. KhaoSahi has no account and no server, so we never receive your data. If Android device backup is on, your phone may include this data in its own backup to your Google account.
notice.whyBody: To show food ratings and a diet plan that suit you, to track your progress and to send the reminders you turn on.
notice.howLongBody: Until you delete it. Uninstalling the app also removes it from this phone.
notice.deleteBody: Go to Settings and tap "Delete all data". You can export a copy first.
notice.adsBody: KhaoSahi shows ads from Google AdMob. Ads may use your phone's advertising ID. No health data is ever shared with ads. You can change ad choices in "Ad privacy options" (when shown) or in your phone's Google settings.
